meta.title: Azure Cloud Sword Immortal
meta.description: Azure Cloud Sword Immortal — a white-haired, black-and-gold sword immortal in the bottom-right corner. 23 standing poses plus a 24-frame sword dance, 22 talisman skins and 10 switchable sounds; the robe switches between ink and white with the light/dark theme. Balance and spend at a glance: the ledger tab breaks today / last 7 days / all time down by model, with searchable per-turn rows; the notice tab covers low balance, per-turn cost, question and approval alerts, a daily budget, the late-night nudge and drink-water reminders. Six panel tabs (data / ledger / sound / look / notices / more) plus a visual bubble editor that adds, removes and reorders lines, edits in-line modules (peak/off-peak goes green off-peak and orange at peak, with a live countdown to the next switch) and sets per-line size / color / bold / italic / underline; Reset in the editor header restores only the target you have open, after one confirmation. The title bar keeps a single balance status dot, with About in the top-right corner. Runs entirely locally: no network calls, no uploads, no tokens spent.
